name: dante
description: The description field has been modified to include contextual details about a Python code snippet with an off-by-one error, error symptoms like "index out of range" and "loop runs one extra iteration," a defined scope for identifying the error line, explaining the cause, and providing a corrected version, common scenarios such as `for i in range(len(lst))` vs. `range(len(lst) - 1)`, and a structured response requiring step-by-step reasoning (e.g., "Analyze loop bounds → Check array indices → Test edge cases").
